conceptPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design the complete startup title screen for STAR GUARD, a polished modern browser arcade spaceship shooter. Landscape 1536x1024. Full-bleed cinematic photoreal 3D key art: a large angular silver spacecraft with cyan engines banking toward camera on the right half, blue Earth curvature below, fractured asteroids and a distant colossal purple alien warship in nebula behind. Left 40% dark navy negative space. Elegant game title menu on left, huge condensed italic white STAR on one line, GUARD below with subtle cyan metallic edge. Under title exact copy 'ONE PILOT. SEVENTEEN WORLDS.' Two dark thin-line select controls labelled 'STARTING SECTOR' with '01 / Earth Orbit' and 'RENDER DETAIL' with 'Cinematic / 2880 x 2400'. Wide bright cyan button 'LAUNCH MISSION'. Small bottom-left 'MOVE  WASD / ARROWS     FIRE  SPACE / CLICK'. Bottom right tiny 'NOVA B   CHAFF C   EMP E'. No other text, badges, browser chrome or fake metrics. Clean deliberate typography, crisp geometric controls, restrained cyan accents, no rounded card container. Full menu is code-native HTML/CSS in implementation; this image is visual concept only. All controls/readability practical at smaller viewport. Cinematic, premium finished PC game title screen.
